The `sha256sums_x86_64` array contains a valid checksum, indicating intent to verify the AppImage, so there is no reliance on `SKIP`. Sourcing the PKGBUILD during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` or `--nobuild` will not execute any malicious payloads. While the `prepare()` and `build()` functions modify the desktop file and extract the AppImage, these stages are not reached under `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`, so they are out of scope for this narrow gate. No data exfiltration or remote code execution occurs during source fetch and parse.
